text: #DAILY_VOCAB 1.Blatantly (Adv)-in an open and unashamed manner. 2.Bereft Of (Phrase)-not having (something that is needed, wanted, or expected). 3.Fugitives (N)-a person who has escaped from captivity or is in hiding. भगोड़ों 4.Hand Over (Phrasal Verb)-pass responsibility to someone else. सौंपना 5.Acrimony (N)-bitterness or ill feeling. कटुता 6.opened up (phrasal verb)-become more communicative or confiding. 7.Sabotages (V)-to damage or spoil something. 8.Pushback (N)-a negative or unfavourable reaction or response. 9.Intercaste (Adj)-existing between or involving two or more castes. 10.Bogey (N)-something that causes problems. 11.Solemnise (V)-to celebrate or perform (a ceremony, esp. of marriage). 12.Invasion (N)-an action or process that affects someone's life in an unpleasant and unwanted way. 13.Inter-Faith (Adj)-involving persons of different religious faiths. 14.Explicit (Adj)-stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.
